problems.wrong: with the number of errors on each side: twelve monthly backtests give only six totals each, too few for a range
problems.why: Each monthly backtest produces one 28-day horizon total, not six totals each (12 totals in all across the 12 backtests in forecast.backtest.how, which split into 6 to build the band and 6 to check it in forecast.interval.how). Also, 'on each side' right after coverage usually means misses above vs below the interval rather than the build half vs check half.
problems.fix: with the number of errors used to build and to check it: twelve monthly backtests split in half give only six totals in each half, too few for a range
